notes_for_editor: Owner and agency are both stated as sources give them, without calling them a disagreement: the county tower list gives the Minnesota Forest Service (Mn MFS) as owner, and the Forest Lookouts page lists the Superior National Forest; neither source says the other is wrong, so the record's agency field is left as is. Aliases: West Bearskin and Palisade (county list); the A-Z list also calls Palisade another name for the Bearskin lookout, which is not cited. The 1922 entry is the county list's Date column and is not confirmed as a build date, so the event is typed 'other'. The June 1922 item is the only staffing evidence; it names five patrolmen (Peterson, Tunmore, Gilstad, Nelson and Anderson) and gives no later staffing. The 1934 and 1958 survey notes give the 90-foot height; height_m 27.4 is the record's value and matches. The Gunflint Lookout mentioned in a social post and some other pages is a different tower and was not used. No photos found. Two WebSearch-equivalent queries and about six page reads. The 1922 date and the owner name rest on one list, hence medium confidence.
